whyItMatters: system passes its argument to command execution in perl, so untrusted input reaching it becomes command injection.
actions: Replace system with IPC::Run or list-form open, passing untrusted data as separate arguments, never interpolated into a command string.
If a shell is required, restrict the command to a fixed allowlist and validate every argument against it.
Re-run the scan and confirm no system call remains reachable from untrusted input.
verification: Rescan shows no system reachable from untrusted input, and command tests with metacharacter input execute safely.
